events.name: 7S Group
events.note: German HR services firm acquired by ManpowerGroup for $140.4 million.
events.quote: On September 3, 2015, ManpowerGroup acquired 7S Group GmbH, a German HR services firm, for $140.4 million.

events.name: CareerBuilder
events.note: Job board bought by private-equity firm Apollo Global Management, later merged with Monster.com in 2024.
events.quote: In June 2017, CareerBuilder was purchased by the private-equity firm Apollo Global Management

events.name: GitHub Jobs
events.note: GitHub announced the deprecation of GitHub Jobs in April 2021 and sunset the site on August 19, 2021.
events.source_title: Deprecation notice: GitHub Jobs site - GitHub Changelog
events.quote: Today we are announcing the deprecation of GitHub Jobs and, on August 19th, will sunset the site entirely.

events.name: Glassdoor
events.note: Employer review and job site bought by Recruit Holdings, the owner of Indeed, for US$1.2 billion.
events.quote: In 2018, the company was acquired by the Japanese company Recruit Holdings (owner of Indeed) for US$1.2 billion.

events.name: Hired
events.note: Tech recruitment marketplace acquired by Vettery, which was part of the Adecco Group.
events.quote: In November 2020, Vettery acquired the technology recruitment platform Hired.

events.name: Identified
events.note: Recruiting startup acquired by Workday along with its artificial intelligence technology.
events.quote: Workday acquired the startup Identified and its artificial intelligence

events.name: Indeed
events.note: Job search site acquired by Japan-based Recruit Co. Ltd. and run as an independent operating unit.
events.quote: On October 1, 2012, Indeed was acquired by Japan-based Recruit Co. Ltd., becoming an independent operating unit.

events.name: Jobr
events.note: Monster.com acquired the San Francisco job search app Jobr in June 2016.
events.source_title: Monster snaps up 'Tinder for jobs' app, Jobr - TechCrunch
events.quote: Monster.com announced this morning it has acquired the San Francisco-based startup Jobr

events.name: Jobvite
events.note: Applicant tracking vendor purchased by K1 Investment Management and merged with JazzHR and NXTThing RPO.
events.quote: In April 2021, K1 Investment Management purchased and merged Jobvite with JazzHR and NXTThing RPO.

events.name: Monster
events.note: Job board merged with CareerBuilder in 2024, with Apollo-managed funds becoming majority owner; Randstad had bought Monster.com in 2016.
events.quote: In September 2024, Monster.com merged with CareerBuilder.

events.name: Oracle Taleo
events.note: Recruiting and talent software vendor acquired by Oracle Corporation for $1.9 billion.
events.quote: On February 9, 2012, Oracle Corporation acquired Taleo Corporation for $1.9 billion.

events.name: Programmed Maintenance
events.note: Australian labour hire company acquired by Persol for $778M.
events.quote: In October 2017, it acquired the Australian labour hire company Programmed Maintenance for $778M.

events.name: SAP SuccessFactors Recruiting
events.note: HR and recruiting software vendor acquired by SAP; the acquisition was completed in February 2012.
events.quote: The acquisition was completed on February 16, 2012.

events.name: SimplyHired
events.note: Job search site purchased by Recruit Holdings, a competitor of Indeed in the same group.
events.quote: In 2016, Recruit Holdings Co., Ltd. purchased Simply Hired.

events.name: Spherion
events.quote: In September 2011, Randstad acquired Spherion for $770 million.

events.name: Stack Overflow Jobs
events.note: Stack Overflow Jobs and Developer Story were discontinued on March 31, 2022, with no successor job board.
events.source_title: The end of Stack Overflow Jobs: here's what it means for you - hackajob
events.quote: On March 31, 2022, we will discontinue Stack Overflow Jobs and Developer Story.

events.name: Torc
events.quote: In 2024, Randstad acquired Torc, an AI-powered talent marketplace, to enhance its digital engineering delivery.

events.name: Vedior
events.quote: In 2008, Randstad acquired Vedior for €3.3 billion and scaled up across Europe.

events.name: Vettery
events.note: Recruitment marketplace startup acquired by the Adecco Group for $100 million USD.
events.quote: The Adecco Group acquired Vettery, a recruitment marketplace startup, for $100 million USD in February 2018.

events.name: Workopolis
events.note: Acquired by Indeed (Recruit Holdings) and shut down as an independent job board; it remains as a white label portal for Indeed's Canadian postings. The Wikipedia article gives both April and June 2018 for the deal.
events.quote: It was acquired by Indeed.com in June 2018 and subsequently shut down as an independent job board.

events.name: Yacht
events.note: Yacht now operates as Randstad Professional, which the Randstad Professional site presents as the combined brand; the page gives no year for the change. The quote was taken from a fetch summary and should be checked against the page text before publishing.
events.quote: yacht gaat verder als randstad professional
